full_details: Gilbert's ticket named the other baker, the shoemaker, and the whittawer, and said near five pounds. You paid the other baker in the High Street forty-one shillings from the belt. Seventeen shillings were left, and that would not reach the shoemaker in Sheep Street. At his board you unpicked the canvas and took forty-two shillings. You paid him forty-four shillings and sixpence, and the fourteen shillings and sixpence that remained paid the whittawer by the bridge for skins. Each page was ruled, and each man was asked to say nothing at Henley Street. Hamnet Sadler, who was owed nothing, saw you cross the street three times. He said it was a kind morning's walk. You said you were buying bread. He said eight loaves' worth. At home the ledger line is the five pounds, whereof forty-two shillings of the Lady Day money, and no names. You sewed the canvas shut in your chamber. Eighteen shillings are in it. Anne does not have it. Your father was not told.
one_sentence: You paid the five pounds and took forty-two shillings out of the canvas.
title: Paid the five pounds
